name: DeFazio Orchard and Greenhouses
description: In Dayville, CT, DeFazio Orchard and Greenhouses raises Blueberries, Apples, Peaches, Pumpkins, and Corn on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
